newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLAR SEES IMPROVED FULL-YEAR 1996 RESULT.
newsitem.headline: POLAR SEES IMPROVED FULL-YEAR 1996 RESULT.

text.p: Polar-Yhtyma Oy said on Friday its full-year 1996 result would
be better than in 1995 when it booked a loss of 44 million
"Polar's total result in 1996 is expected to be better than
last year," the company said in its January-August report.
Polar said building activity had picked up after a slow
early start to the year, but that group net sales on building
operations would still fall from the previous year.
Polar said it expected its rental real estate occupancy
rate to remain at the current level to the end of the year.
In January-August real estate rentals contributed 138
million markka to net sales, up from 126 million in the
Polar said its real estate sales volume would remain at the
1995 level, when properties with a net worth of 167 million
markka were sold, according to the 1995 annual report.
